name: Speaker in a frame at the bottom
what: The speaker in a frame with round top corners at the bottom of the stage, the head (and hands) rising 88 px out of it through the person matte; the frame's width puts the head at the reference's size.
when: Every explainer; a close take gets a narrower frame, a take of several shots is framed shot by shot.
why: « je ne vois que sa tête, pas son buste, c'est le cadrage du tout qui ne va pas » on a close take; validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: The reference's wide frame on a close take
what: Keeping the reference's 942 px frame on a close take, so the frame shows mostly the face.
when: Never by default; only with --keep-frame, which warns.
why: « je ne vois que sa tête, pas son buste ».
doc: SKILL.md § 2. The matte and the frame

name: Lit charcoal stage
what: Charcoal lit from the middle, a vignette, a light on each scene carried by the camera, a red glow drifting in the top right, dust at three depths, a grid of dots at a quarter of the camera's speed.
when: Always (dark theme).
why: « le fond complètement noir ne met pas en valeur le truc, il faut un peu de petits effets ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Flat black stage
what: An all-black ground with only a faint grid of dots.
when: Never (nor flat white in the light theme).
why: « le fond complètement noir ne met pas en valeur le truc ».
doc: SKILL.md § Non-negotiables

name: Light theme
what: The same stage in light: a lit pale ground, white glass, dark ink words, tinted softer shadows, colour glows only; phone, player and film stay dark.
when: On the user's pick (--theme light).
why: Validated as a whole with the dark one.
doc: SKILL.md § The recipe

name: Shadow, glow, gloss and rim on every figure
what: Every figure casts a two-layer soft shadow on the ground, glows in its colour, has a gloss on its upper half and a rim lit from above; a flash of light behind what pops in, a sheen across a card as it lands.
when: Always.
why: « Tu n'utilises pas assez de petites ombres… des petits glows derrière les éléments ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Captions one word at a time
what: The speaker's words one at a time (two when a short one goes with the next), Inter ExtraBold white with a soft shadow, 20 px above the head; verbatim.
when: For the whole short.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Two-line section title
what: Inter ExtraBold in two lines with one Instrument Serif Italic accent, a red box swept behind a line or a red rule under the last; words rise out of a blur one after the other, the old title rising out first.
when: Once per section.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Scenes joined by camera moves
what: A new scene every 4-8 s, joined by a whip (default), right, rise (going deeper), drop, push (an answer), pull, or a cut behind a breather, with the pack's whoosh at the middle.
when: Between ideas; never two of the same in a row when it can be helped.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Light streak across a whip
what: A light streak crosses the frame during a whip pan (a dark speed line in the light theme).
when: On every whip.
why: Kept without being asked, then validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: A scene arrives composed
what: What is placed at the scene's time rides in with the camera; things named one after the other are placed dim and blurred, then lit on their word.
when: Every scene; never an empty stage after a move.
doc: SKILL.md § 3. Read the transcript, write the storyboard

name: Never still
what: Inside a scene the content drifts up 6.5 px a second and grows 0.6 % a second, every figure floats 3 px, the bars' sheen crosses every 3 s, pictures push in slowly.
when: Always; a still stage for more than 2 s is a fault.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Something new every second or so
what: Each phrase that names a thing, a number, a step or a claim gets a figure or a move on its word; about 45 figures and moves in 50 s.
when: Always.
why: « Trop peu d'éléments, on s'ennuie ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Motion blur on everything that moves
what: Each frame averages up to 16 sub-frames over half a frame (a 180 degree shutter); a still figure is painted once.
when: Always.
doc: SKILL.md § The recipe

name: Entrances on expo curves and springs
what: Figures fly in from a side, rise or drop, come up from below, pop on a spring overshooting about 12 %, zoom out of the camera, flip, wipe, are drawn on or typed; exits the same way.
when: Every figure.
why: « Pas du tout After Effects, pas du tout motion design ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Numbered bars with a red edge
what: Bars flying in from the left with labels blurred until each is said, the one explained lit, its verdict pictogram popping at its end; a bar can become the section's header.
when: For a list of things, steps or rules.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Pill
what: A black glass pill with a gloss, a lit rim and a glow, a pictogram at its left; green for the one picked.
when: For a name, a term, a definition.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Tree wired on with a spark
what: Children dropping in, each wired to the parent by a connector drawn on with a spark riding its tip.
when: For a thing made of parts, a cause and its effects, a chain.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Equation and VS with a camera shake
what: Rows of pills and signs (+, =), or a VS sign with a 16 px camera shake and the glitch.
when: For a combination or a comparison.
why: The camera shake on a VS was kept without being asked, then validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Logo or app icon, glowing
what: The user's real logo or app icon as it is, glowing, with rings to make a phone ring.
when: For a product, a tool, a platform.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Phone with sliding screens
what: A phone rising from below with a lit metal rim; screens slide up into it (a hook band, a picture, a grid of icons, an incoming call).
when: For a product shown on a phone.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Image cards and player cards
what: The user's pictures or frames of the take as cards with a slow push, player cards with a play button and a running bar, a grid lit one after the other as a scan.
when: For examples, videos, a series, a search or a crowd.
why: The player cards were kept without being asked, then validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Frames of the take
what: Stills pulled from the take itself for a video card or a phone's screen, with a burst of shutter sounds.
when: When the speaker talks about their own videos.
doc: SKILL.md § 4. Write plan.mjs, then the sound

name: Pictograms and verdict tiles
what: House pictograms (check, cross, search, trophy, phone…), a check on a green tile or a cross on a red one, standing for what the user did not supply.
when: For good or bad, yes or no, and in place of material the user did not give.
why: The verdict pictograms and the pictograms standing for missing material were validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Counter and coloured numbers
what: A number climbing to its value with a gear sound, or coloured words (green, red) for a number.
when: For a number the user said.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Prompt typed letter by letter
what: A prompt typed letter by letter with the typing sound.
when: When a tool is used.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Document pages and a file
what: Document pages dropping in, one tinted green; a file that boils, for what the user sends.
when: For documents and a call to action.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Marks, arrows and pings
what: A circle, frame, underline, strike or box drawn round a thing, a curved arrow drawn on, rings growing out of a node, a callout line to a small label.
when: On the word that stresses or names a thing.
doc: SKILL.md § The figures (stage.mjs)

name: Breather: hard cut to full screen under a flash
what: A hard cut to the speaker full screen (head 45 % of the width, the stage gone) under a 0.82 white flash, a whoosh on the way out; nothing drawn but the captions.
when: On a confession, a punchline, a strong opinion; 2 to 6 s; never in the first 15 s.
why: Kept over five proposals after « un petit effet sur les passages en plein écran ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Breather alternatives: expand, punch, glitch, leak, whip
what: Other ways to dress the cut to full screen: the frame expanding, a zoom punch with a chromatic split, a glitch, a warm light leak, a vertical whip.
when: Only on the user's ask (stage.breath); flash is the default.
why: Proposed, the flash kept over them; kept as alternatives, not refused.
doc: SKILL.md § The recipe

name: Next video as a card preview
what: An end that is a glimpse of the next video is shown in a frame: the clip framed square, rising on a spring with a big swish, an « Up next » badge, the title above, a red progress bar under it.
when: When the end of the take is a preview of the next video.
why: « c'est une preview de la prochaine vidéo: elle n'est pas en plein écran, elle est dans un cadre »; picked.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Stay tuned on the next-video card
what: A « stay tuned » line on the next-video card.
when: Never.
why: « mais retire le stay tuned, ça fait trop ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Next video as phone, upnext or film
what: Other previews of the next video: on a phone with a feed's chrome, an autoplay card with a countdown ring, a strip of film with « Coming soon ».
when: Only on the user's ask; card is the default.
why: Kept as alternatives, not the default.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: The house pack on the big moves
what: The base skills' whoosh on every scene change, the glitch on a hit, the riser into the payoff, the camera flash on the cut to full screen, set on the take's voice.
when: Always.
why: « Il manque les petits whoosh »; « reprends les SFX des deux skills de base ».
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: A light sound on everything that appears
what: Each appearance has a light sound from the Motionix pack (pop, swish, tick, select, confirm, shutter, typing, data…), 15 to 20 LU under the programme, dropped near a big one or another light one.
when: Every figure; never a sound per caption word.
why: « beaucoup plus de petits sons très légers pour l'apparition des éléments ».
doc: plugins/video/references/audio-spec.md § The light sounds of what appears: the Motionix pack (2026-10-05, the explainer)

name: Music bed silent on the breather
what: The bed under the whole short about 16 LU under the voice, silent on the breather that lands the point, back with the next section.
when: Every short with music.
why: The music drop on a breather was kept without being asked, then validated as a whole.
doc: SKILL.md § The explainer language › What it is

name: Nothing over the speaker's face
what: The stage stays above the frame and the caption above the head.
when: Always.
doc: SKILL.md § Non-negotiables

name: Real material or pictograms
what: Only the user's real names, screens and numbers; what they did not supply is drawn with their words and the house's pictograms, or not drawn.
when: Always; the delivery says which.
doc: SKILL.md § Non-negotiables

name: Colours by name in the plan
what: The plan names colours (white, red, green, yellow, tile), never a hex that only works on one theme.
when: Always.

name: Feed safe zones
what: Captions, title, figures, the next-video frame and the face stay inside x 0.095-0.905, y 0.128-0.774; the frame rises to y 0.64, the title comes down to 0.156.
when: Always; after any change to the frame, re-measure the layout.

name: Loudness at -14 LUFS
what: -14 LUFS, true peak -1.0 dBTP, two-pass loudnorm; every family of sound measured as heard before delivery.
when: Always.

when: A bonus asked every time, never on by default.
